items.t: Automatic transmission slips, shifts hard or fails
items.job: Rebuild or replace 4L60-E automatic transmission
items.note: Owners report about $1,500 to $2,000 for a rebuild.

items.t: Slipping when hot and code P1870 from a worn valve body
items.job: Replace transmission valve body and related valves
items.note: Owners report $670 to about $1,000; a full rebuild costs more if wear has gone further.

items.t: ABS kicks in at low speed and the van rolls farther
items.job: ABS diagnosis; clean mounts and replace front wheel speed sensors
items.note: If the ABS module is also bad, the bill can reach about $2,200 as one owner reported.

items.t: ABS warning light from a failed ABS control module
items.job: Replace or rebuild ABS electronic brake control module
items.note: RepairPal lists about $1,030 to $2,390 for 2000-2005 vans; a rebuilt module costs less.

items.t: Battery cable or wiring rubbed through by steering parts
items.job: Replace and re-route positive battery cable
items.note: Damaged brake lines or computers add a lot; one owner paid over $2,100 for the engine and ABS modules.

items.t: Brake lights and hazards can stop working (recall)
items.job: Replace hazard switch or multifunction switch (recall 05V-099)

items.t: Brake lights fail from a worn turn signal switch
items.job: Replace turn signal (multifunction) switch

items.t: Intake manifold gaskets leak coolant
items.job: Replace upper and lower intake manifold gaskets and coolant
items.note: Takes longer on vans with rear A/C. Add an oil change if coolant got into the oil.

items.t: Rough running from the central 'spider' fuel injector
items.job: Replace central (spider) fuel injector assembly
items.note: RepairPal lists about $605 to $777 for fuel injector replacement on a 2002 Astro.

items.t: Misfires from worn ignition parts or vacuum leaks
items.job: Replace distributor cap, rotor, spark plug wires and spark plugs

items.t: Won't start after damp, cold weather from a wet distributor cap
items.job: Replace distributor cap and rotor

items.t: Fuel pump fails and the engine stalls or won't start
items.job: Replace in-tank fuel pump module and fuel filter
items.note: YourMechanic estimates run about $600 to $1,500 depending on year.

items.t: Power steering failure also cuts brake assist
items.job: Replace power steering pump
items.note: A failed belt or idler pulley costs less; a leaking brake booster costs more.

items.t: Low oil pressure and failed main bearings
items.job: Replace engine with a remanufactured 4.3L V6
items.note: One owner paid about $4,600 for an engine replacement.

items.t: Power door locks stop working
items.job: Replace power door lock actuator (one door)
items.note: RepairPal lists about $200 to $270 per door.

items.t: Outside door handles break
items.job: Replace outside door handle (one door)
items.note: YourMechanic lists about $240 for a front door handle on a 2000 Astro.

items.t: Power windows stop going up
items.job: Replace window motor and regulator (one door)

items.t: Brake shudder from warped front rotors
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors

items.t: Steering knuckle can separate from worn lower ball joint (recall)
items.job: Replace both front steering knuckles (recall 03V-328)

items.t: Windshield wipers work on and off or quit (recall)
items.job: Replace wiper motor circuit board and cover (recall 03V-159)

items.t: Rear bucket seat belt can tear in a crash (recall)
items.job: Seat belt repair (recall 97V-057)

items.t: Built-in child seat belt can lock up (recall)
items.job: Integrated child seat belt repair (recall 99V-009)
